summary: Independently reconciled both proposed facts and functionality.md against canonical lines 1-91 and the rendered view. Both changes are supported; existing names and inherited retained knowledge remain unchanged. Examined all six upstream non-retain claims: two behavioral corrections accepted and four compiled-section claims explicitly deferred.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical lines 21-35 independently confirm separate loop and acceptance reads, flag latching, interrupt masking, callback clearing before invocation, and the final register write conditional on callback return. The correction removes an unsupported uninterrupted-assertion guarantee.

Canonical lines 10-87 confirm static history, handler resampling, strict press-time comparison, sample-driven release retention, nonzero HoldUp tests without age checks in pressed branches, and LastState assignment before the optional return-value override. The functionality document agrees and additionally preserves zero-timestamp sentinel behavior.

contradictions.reason: The early-release rejection claim in fact:ccc176fd-7b4d-46a4-94b2-778c68fab618 is contradicted by distinct register tests. A high loop sample can be followed by a low acceptance sample. Proposal fact 0 correctly resolves this.

The continuous-assertion and unconditional release-deadline implications in fact:2bdbc897-ae5d-4cc8-8f0e-d239456830fd are too strong. Acceptance resamples the input, release timing starts through polling, and pressed branches do not expire HoldUp. Proposal fact 1 correctly resolves these issues.

Accepted deferral for fact:c8170eeb-13db-48c5-8cb7-2ef4f5816934, fact:a89cda68-0745-4be4-8117-481c7e522cf7, link:4b408ea1-76fb-49ba-8c8c-a6318df5ac59, and link:181df232-2c0c-4317-8e56-6ff91a78df80. Static declarations support source-level reset-input state and lifetime, but do not establish compiled .sbss membership, aggregate extent, or padding. No section-layout correction or identity assertion is warranted without compiled evidence.
